summary: The guard `if color is None and cmd_name == "less":` in _pipepager was replaced by a comment, leaving an over-indented block that is an IndentationError and, if it parsed, would run less detection for every pager and override explicit color settings.

findings.explanation: The conditional guarding the less/raw-mode detection was removed and turned into a comment. The following indented lines (less_env = ..., if _less_uses_raw_mode ...) now sit under no block, which is an IndentationError and breaks importing click. Even if it parsed, dropping `color is None` and `cmd_name == "less"` would apply LESS=-R injection and color=True to every pager (cat, more) and override an explicit color=False/True from the caller. cmd_name is computed but never used.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore `if color is None and cmd_name == "less":` at 4-space indent above the less_env lines.
